items.title: 54270_Doc Cheatham oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...did you see the television show with Ben Vereen playing Louis Armstrong? [INTERVIEWEE] I didn't see that. But I heard so much about it.

ctx.x: player who could play their act or else the act was lost.

How do you feel when you see Hollywood movies that depict that era, say, well not talking about "Lady Sings the Blues," necessarily, did you see the television show with Ben Vereen playing Louis Armstrong?
I didn't see that. But I heard so much about it.
